author: benerdati
text:
Not every jailbreak is equal. Now labs have a shared way to say how unequal.

FMF's framework scores a bypass on what it unlocks, how far it generalizes, and how easy it is to find and deploy, then bands it Negligible to Critical. Model safety is starting to look like CVE triage.

author: Vivek_khudaniya
text:
AI just cracked legacy RSA encryption.

Google DeepMind published research showing AI-powered signature forgery is now 1,600x more efficient against 1024-bit RSA keys.

text: SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN CVE-2026-19868 is on CISA's KEV after active exploitation. No workaround. Patch Gen7→7.3.4-7013 / Gen8→8.2.3-8015 before the Nov 20 federal deadline. #SonicWall #InfoSec

author: MarkLiugl
text:
OpenAI built a model to hack. You can't use it.

Via OpenAI: GPT-6 Cyber finds and validates exploitable vulnerabilities in a researcher-set scope, and helps write patches — 48.5% on ExploitGym vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber.

author: robang74v2
text: CVE-2026-109469 is a critical CVSS 10.0 vulnerability residing in Microsoft Entra Device Registration: the core cloud identity and device enrollment architecture powering Microsoft Entra ID, formerly Azure AD.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Critical IBM API Connect flaw: CVE-2026-17362 lets unauthenticated attackers create, change or delete tenants. V12 OnPrem 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2 are affected (CVSS 9.8). Upgrade to 12.1.1.3; IBM lists no workaround.

author: aaPanel_TV
text:
Beware! Hackers May Be Using AI and AWS to Control Your Cloud Servers

Security firm Varonis recently unveiled a proof-of-concept tool called NotC2.

author: CryptoNews_op
text:
Keplr just pulled the plug on Google and Apple logins — after users' funds started moving without permission.

The wallet paused social sign-in today following reports of unauthorized transactions. The trail points to Web3Auth, the login provider behind those accounts.

author: MartiniGuyYT
text:
A critical Windows Paint vulnerability could let hackers remotely execute malicious code without authentication or user interaction.

author: f1tym1
text: Technical details and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit code for a critical vulnerability in the open-source design tool Penpot have been publicly disclosed.

author: The_Tradesman1
text:
Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time

WordPress sites can remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for actively exploited CVE-2026-119977 through vulnerable updates.

author: UpwindMDR
text:
Critical - Wanderer Unauth SSRF via trail download (CVE-2026-71495)

Wanderer’s unauthenticated POST /api/v1/trail/download is SSRF when PUBLIC_PRIVATE_INSTANCE is not set to true.

author: DEVOTOMSOLUTION
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) and Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) are on CISA KEV. These runtime bugs are invisible to code review. Patch PHP and Node.js, rebuild container images, restart services.

author: cvedotnew
text:
CVE-2026-17402 · CRITICAL · CVSS 9.9

IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 may allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands due to OS command injection.

author: The_Tradesman1
text:
Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox

WorkOS says an AI-powered hacking agent that breached its internal sales application and accessed customer information was operated by a security researcher who claims the tool escaped its testing environment

author: PixinityTech
text: An exposed secret in a public repo can become a cloud incident before anyone finishes triaging the leak. In its Nov 5 report, Microsoft describes one AI agent moving from GitHub secret hunting to data exfiltration from Azure Key Vault in five minutes.

text:

text: OpenAI Says Its AI Found 81 Firefox Bugs. Who Gets Access—and Who Doesn’t?

author: zeeshankghouri
text:
AI pentesting frameworks are now doing real intrusions.

ARTEX → scan → SSRF/file-upload exploit → web shell → WISP/vshell/AdaptixC2 → credential theft → lateral movement.

Microsoft saw finance targets hit at machine speed.

author: VolyteIn
text:
Ubuntu/Debian users: update apt today (CVE-2026-109518). No reboot needed.

sudo apt install --only-upgrade apt

OpenSSH "sshole" bug: Alpine only.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Step Security reproduced CVE-2026-123158 on an Alpine VM and container: vulnerable OpenSSH on musl without PAM can accept an overlong password for an eligible passwordless account after a failed attempt. Upgrade to OpenSSH 10.6p2 or patched Alpine packages.

author: igor_os777
text: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot | The Hacker News CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1, codenamed SSHole (or *sshole). Unauthenticated attackers can log in to accounts deliberately set up with no usable password.

author: 2logics
text: SonicWall said on Friday that it has patched seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS, the operating system on its firewalls, including an SSL VPN flaw that may already be exploited and lets attackers get around SAML logins and multi-factor authentication.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: New CVE: CVE-2026-17408 (CVSS 9.8). IBM API Connect · Remote code execution. Remote, no login needed. IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

author: hongzh0
text: IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218: authenticated user can craft a message to bypass authorization and gain full admin. Affects 5.0.0–5.0.19; fix 5.0.19 PL1. CVSS 3.1:9.8.

author: Joshua_WD
text: For 10 years, OpenSSH on Alpine let a 257+ character password into accounts that were never supposed to take one. A researcher found it with agents and 12 sshd builds. Who's exposed, how to check, and the testing trick I'd copy.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-107441 (CVSS 9.8), a zero-day out-of-bounds write in Zyxel GS1900 dispatcher.cgi, saw active exploitation before Patch 3 fixed it; Patch 2 left the flaw open. Upgrade all GS1900 models to 2.90 Patch 3 and rotate root credentials.

text: WordPress Zero-Day Under Active Attack: Hackers are targeting a critical flaw in WordPress—the engine powering nearly 40% of the web. The zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code on host servers during the update process itself. CISA

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-46580 (CVSS 8.8) - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to indirect prompt injection via malicious .prompttemplate files. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: The WordPress deadline passed today. CVE-2026-119977 — the update-window flaw — hit its CISA KEV deadline this week. Patching to WordPress 7.1.4 was step one. Step two is check whether anything got in while you were updating. Unexpected admin users.

author: cyberspecpro
text: SonicWall CVE-2026-19868: SSL-VPN using SAML can be bypassed by anyone with valid credentials for another login method, MFA included. In CISA KEV since 6 Nov. Fixed in SonicOS 7.3.4-7013 / 8.2.3-8015, no workaround. CVSS 7.1 to 7.5.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-121614: Docker Sandboxes Unauthenticated Code Execution — Detection. The Zero Day Initiative (ZDI) has published ZDI-26-894, disclosing CVE-2026-121614 — a critical zeroday.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-44688 - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to prompt injection via malicious file/directory names. CVSS 8.8. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.
